# GitHub Release Notes Template

Use this template as the body of a GitHub Release. Keep CHANGELOG.md as the canonical, detailed English change history; this release body is the user-facing summary.

## Language policy

- Write the English section first and keep it complete for all user-facing changes.
- Keep Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese sections aligned with the English user-impacting summary.
- Translate all security notices, data-loss risks, breaking changes, installation changes, and required user actions in full.
- Do not list internal refactors, test-only work, or developer-tooling work in translated sections unless users are affected.
- Preserve the same release version, download links, and upgrade requirements in every language.

---

# Switchboard vX.Y.Z

**Published:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Download:** [Windows 11 x64 Portable](RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_URL)
**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md)
